epochs=30 patience=7: let model converge more, best lr=3e-5. Prior best stopped at epoch 8-12, more runway may stabilize fold 7

warmup=3 at winner lr=3e-5/wd=1e-5: Devlin(2019)+Hu(2022) show warmup stabilises adapter layers. Targeting fold7 test variance (std=1.94, IC positive 10/12 but Sharpe unstable). Projection layer receives 1% lr for 3 epochs before full strength. Prediction: fold7 test improves toward +1.0-2.0, composite beats +1.61
Exp14: huber_delta=0.5. delta=1.0 puts all FX returns in MSE zone (vol~60bps). delta=0.5=1sigma makes loss robust to fold2 fat tails. Cite: Huber1964
Exp15: head_dropout=0.2 (was 0.1). 636K params on 1382 samples. Cite: Srivastava2014 recommends 0.2-0.5 for small datasets, Hu2022 LoRA uses 0.05-0.2 for adapters
